footprint_reference: placeholder XP cube /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3 = 30 cm (BP_PickupXP, bp-pickup-xp); hex 30 cm across corners (X), 25.98 across flats (Y)
warnings: hole emissive is not carried by the FBX: the Unreal material must set the emissive colour (0, 0.9, 1) on M_XPNut_hole

C1.evidence: Hexagonal prism 30 x 25.98 x 11.7 cm, height 45 % of across-flats; still differs: source is slightly taller-looking from its higher camera.

C2.evidence: Hole depth 8.2 cm = 70 % of height; floor visible as a pale ellipse well below the top face; 3 steep + 2 shallow wall bands, far wall lit, near wall hidden by the rim; walls (0,0.9,1) and floor (0.55,0.95,1) are two materials; shallow bands read clearly brighter than steep bands on the far wall. Still differs: source bands are broader and its floor is larger; ours has thinner far-wall bands and a smaller floor.

C3.evidence: Chamfer ring around the hole mouth and 6 bevelled top corners visible as facets; still differs: source bevels are a bit larger.

C4.evidence: Body one mid grey; every hole surface cyan or pale cyan; no other colour.

C5.evidence: tris_out 224 (budget 300); 30 cm across corners; pivot bottom centre.

C6.evidence: Flat shading, large facets, no texture.

C7.evidence: Rim chamfer (pale cyan) is the brightest ring, then the saturated walls, then the floor; still differs: the source rim has a soft glow halo that Blender does not render.
